narrative.details:
Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.

Bring me their heads, adventurer, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
narrative.objectives: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.

When you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
narrative.requestItemsText: I want their heads, adventurer, not excuses.
